title: YourMondayMotivator: Thinking BIG
html:
One of my favorite quotes ever is Donald Trump's, "As long as you are going to think anyway, think big." If you are not aware of how BIG The Don thinks then do a google search on him today.

NZ's own Michael Hill is asking us to Think Bigger in his latest book and have a 30 year goal.

Now a lot of us have goldifsh like attention and can't think beyond the end of the day but I can see the benefit of having a 30 year goal.

In my opinion both Donald Trump and Michael Hill not only think big, they also think long term. There is no quick fix or quick buck for these guys. They are in for the long haul and have amassed a lot of wealth and success because of that.

A game I like to play to see where people are at is to talk about big goals. I love cars and a goal I had this year was to buy a Lamborghini on my birthday and another is to be worth $100M. Big goals like that make many people uncomfortable. They laugh, squirm and even poo poo the idea because it is beyond their thinking and their comfort zone.

Why?

That is a great question. Why are BIG goals beyond most people. I don't know the answer but, I'm very happy people like Thomas Edison and the Wright Brothers thought big, because we wouldnt be able to walk in a room and turn on a light or fly if they hadn't.

Think BIGGER. You deserve the rewards and the world will be a better place when you do.
Have an excellent week and we are getting closer and closer to 500 fans on facebook.com/mondaymotivator. I now have 20 copies of the best book in the world to give away. Please let your friends know and say hello or comment on today's MondayMotivator at facebook.com/mondaymotivator.
